Das Unternehmen ist ein etabliertes Schweizer Handels- und Technologieunternehmen im Bereich CNC-/Fräser-Werkzeugmaschinen und betreut Kunden in der gesamten Schweiz.
## Job Description ##
* Aktive Betreuung und Ausbau des Kundenstamms in der Deutschschweiz
* Gewinnung von Neukunden und systematischer Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen
* Beratung von Kunden bei der Auswahl geeigneter CNC-/Fräser-Werkzeugmaschinen
* Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Beziehungen zu Unternehmen aus Werkzeugbau, Maschinenbau und zerspanender Fertigung
* Identifikation von Marktpotenzialen und neuen Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
* Durchführung von Kundenbesuchen, Produktpräsentationen und technischen Beratungsgesprächen

* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Innendienst sowie den technischen Fachstellen
* Beobachtung des Marktes und der Wettbewerbsentwicklung
## The Successful Applicant ##
* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Polymechaniker, CNC-Mechaniker oder vergleichbare technische Ausbildung
* Fundierte Erfahrung in der CNC-Fertigung, Zerspanung oder im Werkzeugbau
* Idealerweise Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb von Werkzeugmaschinen oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion
* Bestehendes Netzwerk in der Werkzeugbau-, Maschinenbau- oder Zerspanungsbranche von grossem Vorteil
* Technisches Verständnis und Freude daran, komplexe Lösungen kundengerecht zu vermitteln

* Eine verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Position mit viel Eigenständigkeit

We’re expanding our mid-market sales team and looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) who can open doors with real estate brokerages and high-performing large teams. This is a front-line role that feeds the entire mid-market sales organization. The quality of your work directly affects how fast we grow.

Our Mid-Market team is newer, operating like a startup within Luxury Presence. If you want a role where you solve real problems, learn fast, take ownership, and build the foundation for a successful sales career, this is it.

Prospect and qualify mid-market opportunities with real estate brokerages and large teams, focusing on deals in the $30K - $250K ACV range.
Run high-quality outbound outreach across phone, email, and social channels to reach brokers, team leads, and executives.
Develop a sharp understanding of how brokerages operate, make technology decisions, and grow their business.
Create qualified meetings for Mid-Market Account Executives with clear discovery and qualification criteria.
Build and maintain your own pipeline from scratch. This role requires a high degree of ownership and self-prospecting.
Track activity, learn from data, and continuously refine your approach to improve conversion.
Work closely with sales leadership to sharpen targeting, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.

1+ years of experience in a lead generation or business development role using phone, email, or social outreach.
Experience prospecting into mid-market or enterprise accounts. Real estate industry experience is highly preferred.
Familiarity with outbound prospecting tools and CRM systems (Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar).
Strong verbal communication skills with a polished, confident telephone presence.

Self-starter who thrives without a playbook. You build your own pipeline and figure out what works.

Curious about real estate and genuinely interested in understanding how brokerages and teams run their businesses.
Comfortable in a fast-paced, startup-like environment where priorities shift and ownership is expected.
Strong project management habits. You stay organized across multiple accounts, channels, and follow-up sequences.

We’re a team of 300+ Thinkers building products that matter. Every role at Thinkific contributes to raising the bar for online learning, supporting thousands of learning businesses, and creating real-world impact for millions of learners around the world. You’ll work alongside curious, collaborative teammates who care deeply about what they build and who they build it for.

Are you an ambitious relationship builder who thrives on connecting with people and creating new opportunities?
We're looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our growing sales team as a high-impact, all-bound pipeline driver. This isn't a siloed inbound or outbound role — you'll own both, working the full top of funnel with equal fluency. You'll be the first impression Thinkific makes on prospective customers, and you'll be expected to operate like a modern, AI-native seller: smart targeting, sharp messaging, fast execution.
You'll work closely with our Account Executive team and marketing to help build a qualified pipeline, run signal-based outbound plays, and ensure no inbound lead goes unworked. You'll be expected to use AI tools not as a shortcut, but as a force multiplier — doing more, personalizing better, and moving faster than a traditional SDR.

Own inbound lead qualification: respond fast, qualify rigorously, and book quality meetings for our AE team
Build and execute outbound sequences targeting our ICP, using Clay, Gong, Sales Navigator, and AI-driven research to personalize at scale
Run signal-based prospecting using buying triggers (hiring activity, tech stack changes, funding events, content engagement) to prioritize outreach
Execute multi-channel sequences across email, phone, LinkedIn, etc.
Partner with AEs to align on target accounts, messaging, and pipeline goals
Hit and exceed monthly goals
Continuously test and iterate messaging; bring a hypothesis-driven mindset to what's working and why

1-2 years of SDR/BDR experience in B2B SaaS (bonus points for learning tech, HR tech, or an adjacent space)
Demonstrated ability to self-source pipeline through outbound, not just work inbound queues
Hands-on experience with AI-powered sales tools like Clay, Apollo,Gong etc; you should be able to show us your workflow, not just list the tools you’ve used
Proficiency with Salesforce (or equivalent CRM) and a sequencing tool (Outreach, Salesloft, or Gong)
Strong written communication, your emails sound like you, and your cold calls don't sound like scripts

Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment

About League
League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call.

That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale.

Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side.

This is a build-your-craft role at the front of League's enterprise motion. You will work alongside two to three Account Directors, prospecting into their assigned book of business as the first point of contact between League and healthcare executives owning digital, member experience, AI initiatives, and innovation across North America.
Your core responsibility is conducting deep account research to map League's value proposition to real organizational challenges, then deploying agentic outreach sequences across email, LinkedIn, and direct calls to create discovery meetings and pipelines.
League is an AI-first company and this role is built that way. You will have the tools to research and sequence at a depth that used to take a team, and the support to keep improving how you use them. Your central mandate is to run League's go-to-market system with rigor, and to make it better from the inside.
What You'll Own
Account research and point of view
Research accounts in your Account Directors' book at the level of their actual business: quality performance, digital and AI roadmaps, recent leadership changes, earnings commentary, public filings and app store reviews.
Map League's value proposition to account-specific challenges to build points of view that drive early engagement.
Bring League executives and subject matter experts into accounts where a peer-level conversation opens a door that a rep cannot.
Outreach and pipeline creation
Build and deploy agentic outreach sequences on League's technology stack, across email, LinkedIn and direct calls.
Generate discovery meetings and pipeline while providing Account Directors with high-context research for first calls.
Support marketing events, campaigns and initiatives where League's prospects are a good fit, and follow up on the interest they generate.
The system itself
Execute the go-to-market system with discipline while refining underlying AI workflows, skills, and agents, and share what works with the rest of the team.
Partner with the Marketing team to analyze and iterate on market messaging.
Keep Salesforce accurate and current, because pipeline decisions above you are made from what you record.
Learn the enterprise sales motion end to end, from first touch through opportunity progression.

Ensure access management is performed in compliance with your role and responsibilities.
Execute League's policies and procedures within your team and engagements.
Notify HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches, or policy violations.
Comply with Information Security Policies.

Two+ years of outbound sales experience into large enterprises (ideally healthcare). We are hiring for trajectory, not tenure.
A genuine, organic interest in building a sales development career.
Track record of reaching and engaging executive-level buyers.
Fluency with Claude or other AI-native tools, and evidence you fold them into your day-to-day rather than treating them as an add-on.
Strong written communication.
Real curiosity about healthcare and how it is changing. You do not need to know the US healthcare system on day one; you do need to be the kind of person who goes and learns it.
Experience with long, committee-driven enterprise sales cycles.
Experience working alongside senior sellers on account strategy.
Helpful, not required
Exposure to payers, health systems, benefits administrators or consumer health organizations.
Familiarity with Star Ratings, HEDIS, care gaps, benefits navigation and digital front door.
Experience with Salesforce, sales engagement platforms, Artisan or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
Experience building your own AI workflows, skills or agents.
How You Work
Beyond the functional bar, this seat calls for a specific way of operating:
You listen as well as you talk. You are comfortable picking up the phone and going outbound, and equally able to sit back, hear what is actually being said, and take it in. Neither mode is a stretch for you.
You keep up. You process new information fast: new market, new structure, new process; and you can hold pace with a team that moves quickly..
You run the play. You buy into the system that has been built for you and execute it with discipline. You surface your ideas rather than quietly launching your own version of the stack.
You grind, then you think. You genuinely enjoy the daily rhythm of the work. Within it, you connect dots and find creative angles that the process alone would not produce.
You do the thing every day. You are consistent and process-oriented. Results here come from showing up the same way every morning.
You are discerning with your time. You will be pulled by several Account Directors at once. You know what to say yes to, what to sequence, and what to push back on.
You ask the hard question. You are supportive and easy to work with, and you still challenge assumptions. This team is optimistic by nature and benefits from someone willing to press constructively.
You are self-directed. When something is unfamiliar, you go read, listen and dig until you can hold your own on it. You share your ideas and learnings with others on the team.
You want to win. You lead yourself, you compete, and you bring the energy to keep up with the people around you.
What Success Looks Like
Meetings that hold. You consistently create discovery meetings with the right executives, and your Account Directors walk in with context they did not have to build themselves.
Pipeline that progresses. Opportunities you source advance past first meeting because you stayed in the account and helped shape qualification.
The system gets sharper. Your AI workflows and sequences improve measurably over your first two quarters, and other people on the team adopt what you built.
You know the market. Within months you can hold a credible conversation about US payer and health system dynamics with someone who does it for a living.
You are trusted with more. You have the fundamentals of the enterprise sales motion under you and a clear path toward owning accounts.

Bei der Mobiliar Generalagentur Wil legen wir Wert auf nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen und hohe Servicequalität. Im Verkaufssupport leistest du einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur zielgerichteten Unterstützung unseres Beraterteams und zur professionellen Betreuung unserer Kundinnen und Kunden.

Dafür suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeberaterinnen und -berater im Tagesgeschäft unterstützt und aktiv zur verlässlichen Betreuung unserer Kundschaft beiträgt.

Mit deiner strukturierten Arbeitsweise und deinem Dienstleistungsverständnis stärkst du das Vertrauen in die Mobiliar als persönlichste Versicherung der Schweiz.
## Das bewirkst du bei uns ##
Du unterstützt unsere Versicherungsberaterinnen und -berater im operativen Alltag und übernimmst eigenverantwortlich administrative und koordinierende Aufgaben.
Dazu gehören die Erstellung von Korrespondenz, Auswertungen sowie die Bearbeitung von Offerten, Anträgen und Vertragsunterlagen. Im direkten Kundenkontakt am Telefon oder am Schalter betreust du unsere Kundschaft kompetent und verlässlich.
Du beantwortest Anfrage und koordinierst Termine über sämtliche Versicherungsbranchen hinweg. Als Teil des Verkaufssupportteams arbeitest du eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen und stellst reibungslose Abläufe sicher.
## Das bringst du mit ##
* Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung und oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung innerhalb der Versicherungsbranche
* Ausbildung Versicherungsvermittler oder Versicherungsvermittlerin VBV oder Bereitschaft, diese zu absolvieren
* Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein
* Interesse an einem vielseitigen Tätigkeitsfeld und Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen
* Strukturierte, selbständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Teamorientierung, hohe Hilfsbereitschaft und professionelle Grundhaltung
## Bei uns arbeiten ##
Auf der Generalagentur Wil erwartet dich ein engagiertes und vielfältiges Team. Gemeinsam stärken wir unsere regionale Verankerung und schaffen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden konsistente 5 Sterne Erlebnisse. Wir pflegen einen offenen, respektvollen und kollegialen Austausch und arbeiten lösungsorientiert sowie verantwortungsbewusst zusammen. Dich erwarten klare Strukturen, kurze Entscheidungswege, eine sorgfältige Einführung sowie zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen bei der Mobiliar.
Dein Arbeitsort ist auf unserer Hauptagentur in Ebnat-Kappel und der Stellenantritt erfolgt nach Vereinbarung.
Das Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz verlangt zur Ausübung dieser Funktion den Abschluss Versicherungsvermittler/-in VBV, Profil Allbranche. Sollte dieser nicht vorhanden sein, unterstützen wir gerne mit massgeschneiderten internen Ausbildungen.

Sind wir erfolgreich, profitieren auch unsere Mitarbeitenden. Jedes Jahr wird über die Ausschüttung einer Erfolgsbeteiligung und deren Höhe entschieden.

Wir bieten ein vielfältiges internes Kursangebot an. Bei jobrelevanten Weiterbildungen beteiligen wir uns.

Wir bieten unter anderem bis zu 25% Prämienrabatt, Rabatte auf Mobiltelefone sowie kostenlose Abonnemente mit Flatrate und Ermässigungen bei kulturellen Veranstaltungen.

s.h: ## CE QUE TU PEUX FAIRE BOUGER ##
s.t:
En tant que Consultant en automatisation UiPath (tous genres), tu feras partie de notre équipe Agentic Automation Platform et travailleras à la conception, au développement et à l-amélioration continue de solutions d-automatisation modernes. Tu combines une expertise technique avec une compréhension des processus et des exigences de nos clients.
* **Conception & développement :** Tu conçois, développes et implémentes des solutions d-automatisation modernes avec UiPath et les accompagnes tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
* **Analyse des processus :** Tu analyses les processus métier et identifies, avec les clients et les départements concernés, les potentiels d-automatisation appropriés.
* **Automatisation :** Tu mets en œuvre des workflows robustes et maintenables avec UiPath Studio et Orchestrator et soutiens leur exploitation et leur évolution.
* **Conseil client :** Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec les analystes métier, les clients et les interlocuteurs techniques et traduis les exigences métier en solutions techniques.
* **Normes :** Tu soutiens l-introduction et le développement continu des standards et des meilleures pratiques d-automatisation.
* **Responsabilité de projet :** Selon ton expérience, tu assumes de plus en plus de responsabilités dans les projets et évolues vers un niveau senior.
* **Travail d-équipe :** Tu t-impliques activement dans notre équipe et dans les échanges professionnels autour de l-automatisation métier.

* **Formation :** Tu as une formation achevée ou un diplôme dans le domaine de l-informatique, du génie logiciel ou dans une discipline comparable.
* **Expérience professionnelle :** Tu disposes d-une première à plusieurs années d-expérience dans le développement de solutions d-automatisation avec UiPath.
* **Connaissances UiPath :** Tu évolues au moins au niveau Professional Developer et peux développer et mettre en œuvre des solutions UiPath de manière autonome.

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
With Lyft Business, sales isn't a script you follow. It's a problem you solve in real time. As a Business Associate for Lyft Business, you'll drive new growth in a market where transportation touches nearly every part of daily life. Success here isn't just about closing deals; it's about the persistence to build a healthy pipeline from scratch and the judgment to advise each prospect like a trusted partner to win or grow their business with us.
This job rewards people who move fast and think on their feet. Priorities will evolve, systems are still maturing, and you won't always have a playbook for every situation but you'll have the opportunity to make an impact as we figure it out. The people who thrive here are the ones who are resourceful, hard to rattle, and genuinely motivated by figuring things out as they go, especially when it comes to earning a customer's trust without a rehearsed pitch.
You'll focus on small and mid-sized businesses and show them how Lyft Business can solve their transportation needs. In this hybrid role, you will balance inbound and outbound outreach covering everything from onboarding new businesses to growing your existing book of business. You’re the hunter and the farmer: building relationships meant to last, and every interaction should reflect well on Lyft Business.
You'll be part of a driven, tight-knit sales team that’s laser-focused on winning new business. We're looking for people who know how to hustle, work well with others, stay locked in on results while helping organizations get the most out of what Lyft Business has to offer.

Reach out to a wide range of stakeholders across the SMB space, turning inbound leads into Lyft Business customers, as well as re-engaging existing customers with our newest product offerings.
Keep Salesforce as your source of truth by diligently logging activity and being adamant on keeping your pipeline pristine.
Dig into what's holding a prospect back, ask the right questions to surface real concerns, and shape a pitch that actually fits their business.
Actively incorporate AI into your workflow to identify high quality prospects, tailor messaging, and refine pitch delivery
Stay clear headed and positive when priorities move or the path forward isn't obvious, and keep pushing deals toward value for both the client and Lyft.
Juggle a large, active book of business without dropping the ball — every touchpoint should land on time and feel polished.
Grow your book of business consisting of small and mid-sized companies through a steady mix of calls and meetings, converting them into customers and/or growing their spend with us.
Commit to a daily rhythm of outbound calls (50+) so your pipeline never runs dry.
Make a strong first impression in every interaction, representing Lyft with the kind of professionalism that turns a first meeting into a lasting partnership.
Track your numbers closely week to week, keep your calendar full of appointments, and stay ahead of your goals rather than chasing them.

Minimum 1 year of experience in sales or business development
You demonstrate persistence and a high tolerance for rejection in a fast-paced environment
You are comfortable thinking on your feet and have a natural curiosity to ask the right questions
Proven experience in a quota-carrying role with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
Experience developing an account prioritization framework and contact identification strategies.
Ability to search for and identify prospective business opportunities aligned with business strategy.
Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

* You will have the opportunity to apply your technical knowledge to challenging cases and assist in delivering **presentations** to clients and colleagues.
* You will lead **complex tax consulting briefings** with clients on intricate cross-border assignments, providing clear, practical advice on Swiss tax and social-security implications. You will build and maintain client relationships as the primary point of contact, coordinate with international teams on multi-jurisdictional matters.

Notre client, une structure spécialisée dans l'entretien des fibres textiles, est à la recherche d'un.e commercial.e B2B et B2C afin de continuer de développer la société.

Tu t'occuperas donc de la prospection, du cold-calling, des meetings et élaboration de devis jusqu'à la signature des contrats.
